title_en: Artificial Intelligence (11/20): Face Recognition at the Door
note_en: The pattern 不但……还…… means "not only... but also...": 这样不但方便，还能防止外人冒用别人的门卡 "this is not only convenient but also keeps outsiders from using someone else's key card." Unlike English, where "not only" can trigger inversion ("Not only is it..."), Chinese keeps normal word order and simply puts 不但 after the subject (if there is one) and 还 or 也 before the second verb.
